concepts.label: Mid
concepts.description: Midpoint of best yes-bid and yes-ask. Untradeable reference price.

concepts.label: Spread
concepts.description: Best ask − best bid (¢). Wide spreads = poor liquidity; prefer postOnly.

concepts.label: Crossed book
concepts.description: Transient book state (yesBid + noBid > 100). Do not treat mid as tradeable.

concepts.label: Avg volume (Fp)
concepts.description: Mean resolved Kalshi contract volume over trading appearances (player_profiles). Not poly; not a single-tick kalshi_volume.

concepts.label: Yes price ¢
concepts.description: Limit price for YES contracts, 1–99¢. NO price = 100 − yes.

concepts.label: Balance
concepts.description: Available-to-trade cash. Does not include value locked in open positions.

concepts.label: Portfolio value
concepts.description: Current mark value of all held positions, separate from cash balance.

concepts.label: Position
concepts.description: Signed contracts: positive = long YES, negative = long NO (Kalshi convention).

concepts.label: Exposure
concepts.description: Cash at risk in this market at current marks.

concepts.label: Realized P&L
concepts.description: Locked-in profit/loss from closed trades in this market.

concepts.label: Fees paid
concepts.description: Total exchange fees paid in this market, all time.

concepts.label: Remaining
concepts.description: Contracts still working on the book (not yet filled or canceled).

concepts.label: Fill count
concepts.description: Contracts already executed from this order.

concepts.label: Taker
concepts.description: True = crossed the spread (taker fee); false = rested on book (maker fee, lower).

concepts.label: Fee ¢
concepts.description: Exchange fee on this fill. Maker < taker — postOnly orders target maker fees.

concepts.label: Post-only
concepts.description: Maker-first: order rests on book or is rejected; never crosses the spread.

concepts.label: Dry-run
concepts.description: Simulated order — no funds move, no API write. Live requires explicit opt-in.

concepts.label: Shadow min signals
concepts.description: Gate: minimum shadow signals before a program may graduate to pilot.

concepts.label: Kill Brier drift %
concepts.description: Gate: kill program if Brier score drifts this % above baseline.

concepts.label: Graduation edge ¢/fill
concepts.description: Gate: realized edge per fill needed for pilot→live.

concepts.label: League
concepts.description: Professional circuit derived from Kalshi series (ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF).

concepts.label: Surface
concepts.description: Court type: Hard, Clay, Grass, Carpet (from event or tournament seed).

concepts.label: Tier
concepts.description: Competition level (GS, 1000, 500, 250, CH, ITF15–100, …).

concepts.label: Round
concepts.description: Match round within the tournament (R16, QF, SF, F, …).

concepts.label: Series
concepts.description: Kalshi series ticker family (e.g. KXATPMATCH).

concepts.label: Gender
concepts.description: Competition gender classification on the desk export.

concepts.label: Age group
concepts.description: Age band when present (junior/senior); often empty on tour.

concepts.label: Match UUID
concepts.description: Stable match identity for desk joins.

concepts.label: Event ticker
concepts.description: Kalshi event ticker (market grouping key).

concepts.label: Timestamp
concepts.description: Snapshot capture time for the desk row.

concepts.label: Player A
concepts.description: Side A player display name on the desk row.

concepts.label: Player B
concepts.description: Side B player display name on the desk row.

concepts.label: Title
concepts.description: Match / event title string on the desk export.

concepts.label: Kalshi µ
concepts.description: Kalshi mid (implied probability cents) on the desk snapshot.

concepts.label: Kalshi spread
concepts.description: Kalshi bid–ask spread on the desk snapshot.

concepts.label: Kalshi volume
concepts.description: Kalshi contract volume on the desk tick (not player-profile average).

concepts.label: Poly mid
concepts.description: Polymarket mid price, cents; null when venue absent.

concepts.label: Poly volume
concepts.description: Polymarket volume USD; null = venue absent, 0 = joined with zero trades.

concepts.label: Pinnacle no-vig
concepts.description: Pinnacle no-vig probability in cents; null when unavailable.

concepts.label: Pinnacle source
concepts.description: mock | live — origin of pinny_no_vig.

concepts.label: Elo prob
concepts.description: Elo win probability for player A (0–1); interpret with elo_source.

concepts.label: Elo source
concepts.description: model | fallback_50 | missing — provenance of elo_prob.

concepts.label: Blend fair ¢
concepts.description: Blended fair price in cents (core priced output).

concepts.label: Eff edge
concepts.description: Effective edge vs blend (cents); tick-bound, can drift.

concepts.label: Liquidity OK
concepts.description: Desk liquidity gate (necessary, not sufficient for tradable).

concepts.label: Total volume USD
concepts.description: Combined venue volume in USD for the match snapshot.

concepts.label: Multi-venue
concepts.description: Whether more than one venue is joined on the row.

concepts.label: Arb hint
concepts.description: Directional arb signal (kalshi-cheap | poly-cheap | none | watch).

concepts.label: Arb actionable
concepts.description: Hard arb gate (net edge > 0 on real venue-vs-venue).

concepts.label: RPS flag
concepts.description: Research process signal flag on the desk row.

concepts.label: Graph divergence
concepts.description: Graph/model divergence indicator on the desk export.

concepts.label: Research flag
concepts.description: Research gating reason (e.g. DATA_INCOMPLETE, thin-data).

concepts.label: Export note
concepts.description: Per-row provenance string (e.g. mock pinny caveat).

concepts.label: Player profiles
concepts.description: Derived from event-store player_profiles (SSOT). Rebuild: bun run tennis:profiles:build.

concepts.label: Last seen
concepts.description: Epoch millis of latest event start for this player. Capped ≤ now. Event-store ms.

concepts.label: Profiles source
concepts.description: warehouse = rows from event-store; seed = unavailable / fixture path.

concepts.label: Coverage
concepts.description: Data completeness for a tour/surface slice (events with books, links, scores).

concepts.label: Surface edge
concepts.description: Dampened percentage-point edge from each player's historical surface win rates vs the match surface.

concepts.label: Reset filters
concepts.description: Clear all active Events facet selections and sort order.

concepts.label: Tennis board
concepts.description: Real-time match monitor: open Kalshi markets with filters, surface edge, and player profiles.

concepts.label: Scanner
concepts.description: Price divergence alert: when market mid deviates from model fair by more than threshold.

concepts.label: Divergence
concepts.description: Cents difference between market price and model fair price.

concepts.label: Edge score
concepts.description: Composite signal strength: divergence weighted by liquidity and model confidence.

concepts.label: Model suspect
concepts.description: Flag when model inputs are stale, incomplete, or conflict with market consensus.

concepts.label: Tournament
concepts.description: Filter matches by tournament / competition name.

concepts.label: Country
concepts.description: Filter by tournament or player nationality code/name.

concepts.label: When
concepts.description: Time window filter: live, today, next 24h, this week.

concepts.label: Liquidity
concepts.description: Filter by quote presence: priced or actively trading.

concepts.label: Min 24h vol
concepts.description: Minimum trailing volume gate for board rows (desk liquidity).

concepts.label: Min surface edge
concepts.description: Minimum surface-edge points required to keep a match on the board.

concepts.label: Sort
concepts.description: Ordering of the match list: start time, volume, or name.

concepts.label: Unclassified
concepts.description: Placeholder when a value cannot be mapped to a known category.

concepts.label: Coverage
concepts.description: Data completeness badge: Kalshi-only, Polymarket-only, or hybrid.

concepts.label: Poly
concepts.description: Polymarket market link status: linked or unlinked.

concepts.label: Event status
concepts.description: Match lifecycle: Scheduled, Live, or Ended.

concepts.label: Events
concepts.description: Number of matches in the current filtered view.

concepts.label: Total volume
concepts.description: Aggregated volume across the filtered match set.

concepts.label: Scanner signal
concepts.description: Abstract scanner / divergence-alert concept used by live board UI.

concepts.label: Price divergence
concepts.description: Abstract market-vs-model divergence concept.

concepts.label: Edge score
concepts.description: Abstract composite edge strength concept.

concepts.label: Model suspect
concepts.description: Abstract model-trust flag concept.

concepts.label: Poly Dropout
concepts.description: kalshiOnly % exceeds threshold (>30% default) for N logger cycles. Polymarket matching failing.

concepts.label: Volume Gap
concepts.description: midOnly exceeds threshold (>10 default) for N cycles. Many mids but zero volume — stale volume_fp.

concepts.label: Poly Feed Frozen
concepts.description: polyMatched=0 for N consecutive cycles. Polymarket feed completely frozen.

concepts.label: Feed Stale
concepts.description: No snapshots within staleness-threshold-ms (120s). Logger stuck or crashed.

concepts.label: Price Divergence
concepts.description: Kalshi mid deviates from Poly implied prob > divergence-cents (15¢). Cross-venue mispricing.

concepts.label: Alert Resolution
concepts.description: Auto-sent when active alert clears. Includes duration, replies original, clears debounce.

concepts.label: Alert Delivery
concepts.description: Telegram (HTML, threaded, keyboard CRITICAL), Discord/Slack webhook, console stderr.

concepts.label: Alert Severity
concepts.description: CRITICAL: feed down (keyboard). WARNING: degraded. INFO: informational, silent.
